name: DEHNet
definition: A convolutional neural network trained to synthesize a Diffraction-Engineered Hologram (DEH) wave field directly from an all-in-focus color image and an all-in-focus depth map, replacing the computationally expensive optimization-based DEH generation.
summary: DEHNet is a neural network that synthesizes holographic wave fields from color and depth images, offering real-time performance and superior defocus control compared to optimization-based methods.
